points.title: 早年成长
points.description: 拉夫连季·贝利亚1899年出生于格鲁吉亚苏呼米的一个贫困家庭。他的父亲是当地一位农民，母亲是家庭主妇。贝利亚接受了良好的教育，在巴库技术学院学习建筑。在此期间，他接触到了革命思想，并开始参与政治活动。这段时期的生活塑造了他后来的政治理念和冷酷性格，为他日后在苏联政治舞台上的崛起奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: Lavrentiy Beria was born in 1899 in Sukhumi, Georgia, into a poor family. His father was a local peasant and his mother a housewife. Beria received a good education and studied architecture at the Baku Technical Institute. During this period, he was exposed to revolutionary ideas and began engaging in political activities. This formative period shaped his later political ideology and冷酷 personality, laying the foundation for his future rise in Soviet politics.

points.title: 秘密警察崛起
points.description: 1921年，贝利亚加入格鲁吉亚共产党，并迅速进入秘密警察系统。他以外高加索地区为基地，建立了自己的权力网络。贝利亚以其高效和残酷的手段镇压反对派，清洗党内异己。他建立了格鲁吉亚的秘密警察机构，并逐步扩展到整个外高加索地区。这一时期，贝利亚展现了非凡的组织能力和冷酷无情的工作作风，为他赢得了斯大林的赏识，也为他日后在莫斯科的晋升铺平了道路。
points.descriptionEn: In 1921, Beria joined the Communist Party of Georgia and quickly entered the secret police system. Based in the Transcaucasus region, he built his own power network. Beria used efficient and brutal methods to suppress opposition and purge party dissidents. He established the secret police apparatus in Georgia and gradually expanded it throughout the entire Transcaucasus region. During this period, Beria demonstrated exceptional organizational skills and a ruthless work ethic, earning Stalin's favor and paving the way for his future promotion to Moscow.

points.title: 内务人民委员
points.description: 1938年，贝利亚被斯大林调往莫斯科，担任内务人民委员，领导苏联的秘密警察机构NKVD。在大清洗期间，贝利亚负责执行斯大林的镇压政策，逮捕、审讯和处决了数百万苏联公民。他建立了古拉格劳改营系统，将数百万政治犯送往这些劳改营。尽管如此，贝利亚也负责苏联的情报工作和反间谍活动，在二战期间发挥了重要作用。他还负责监督苏联的原子弹计划，确保了苏联核武器的成功研发。
points.descriptionEn: In 1938, Beria was transferred to Moscow by Stalin to serve as People's Commissar of Internal Affairs, leading the Soviet secret police agency NKVD. During the Great Purge, Beria was responsible for implementing Stalin's repression policies, arresting, interrogating, and executing millions of Soviet citizens. He established the Gulag labor camp system, sending millions of political prisoners to these camps. Despite this, Beria also oversaw Soviet intelligence and counter-espionage activities, playing a significant role during World War II. He was also responsible for supervising the Soviet atomic bomb program, ensuring the successful development of nuclear weapons in the USSR.

points.title: 权力巅峰
points.description: 二战后，贝利亚的权力达到顶峰，他同时担任内务部长、苏联部长会议副主席等多个重要职务。他负责苏联的核武器计划，并主导了东欧国家的安全机构建立。然而，随着斯大林健康状况恶化，贝利亚开始策划权力交接，试图在斯大林死后掌权。他推动了一些相对自由化的政策，如释放部分政治犯、改善与西方的关系等，试图为自己争取支持。这一时期，贝利亚成为苏联政坛最具影响力的人物之一，但也因此引起了其他领导人的警惕和不满。
points.descriptionEn: After World War II, Beria's power reached its peak as he simultaneously held multiple important positions, including Minister of Internal Affairs and Deputy Chairman of the Council of Ministers. He oversaw the Soviet nuclear weapons program and led the establishment of security agencies in Eastern European countries. However, as Stalin's health deteriorated, Beria began planning for the transition of power, attempting to seize control after Stalin's death. He pushed for some relatively liberal policies, such as releasing some political prisoners and improving relations with the West, in an effort to gain support. During this period, Beria became one of the most influential figures in Soviet politics, but this also aroused the suspicion and dissatisfaction of other leaders.

points.title: 失势与处决
points.description: 1953年斯大林去世后，贝利亚试图夺取最高权力，但很快遭到赫鲁晓夫、马林科夫等领导人的联合反对。他被指控为'英国间谍'、'人民公敌'等罪名，并被解除所有职务。在一场匆忙的审判后，贝利亚于1953年12月被处决。贝利亚的死亡标志着苏联政治的一个转折点，也象征着斯大林时代秘密警察统治的终结。他的倒台后，苏联开始了一系列的去斯大林化进程，秘密警察的权力受到限制，政治氛围相对缓和。
points.descriptionEn: After Stalin's death in 1953, Beria attempted to seize supreme power but was quickly opposed by a coalition of leaders including Khrushchev, Malenkov, and others. He was accused of being a 'British spy,' 'enemy of the people,' and other charges, and was stripped of all his positions. After a hasty trial, Beria was executed in December 1953. Beria's death marked a turning point in Soviet politics and symbolized the end of the secret police rule characteristic of the Stalin era. His downfall was followed by a process of de-Stalinization in the USSR, with the power of the secret police being curtailed and the political climate becoming relatively more relaxed.

appraisal.zh: 贝利亚的历史定位并不势均力敌：学界主流视他为斯大林暴政的主要执行者，大清洗中的大规模镇压、古拉格系统的建立与无数家庭的悲剧都记在他名下，酷刑、逼供与大规模处决使其成为极权恐怖的象征。也有研究者指出，他领导战时情报工作、在苏联核计划中作用关键，斯大林去世后还推动释放部分政治犯等自由化举措。但这类务实面远不足以抵消其人道代价，其生涯恰是苏联体制现代化与镇压并行的缩影。
appraisal.en: Beria's standing is not a balanced one: the scholarly mainstream regards him as the chief enforcer of Stalinist tyranny, holding him responsible for the mass repression of the Great Purge, the building of the Gulag system, and countless ruined families, with torture, forced confessions, and mass executions making him a symbol of totalitarian terror. Some researchers note that he led wartime intelligence, played a crucial role in the Soviet nuclear program, and after Stalin's death pushed liberalizing measures such as releasing some political prisoners. Yet this pragmatic side hardly offsets the human cost; his career epitomizes a Soviet system that pursued modernization and repression together.

supporter.zh: 贝利亚的支持者认为他是苏联国家安全和工业化的关键人物。他们强调他在二战期间领导情报工作的贡献，以及在苏联核武器计划中的关键作用。支持者还指出，贝利亚在斯大林去世后推动的一些自由化政策，如释放部分政治犯，显示了他相对务实的一面。他们认为贝利亚是苏联强大国防体系的奠基人之一，为苏联成为超级大国做出了不可磨灭的贡献。
supporter.en: Supporters of Beria view him as a key figure in Soviet national security and industrialization. They emphasize his contributions to leading intelligence work during World War II and his crucial role in the Soviet nuclear weapons program. Supporters also note that some liberalizing policies he pushed after Stalin's death, such as releasing some political prisoners, showed his relatively pragmatic side. They consider Beria one of the founders of the Soviet Union's powerful defense system, making indelible contributions to the USSR becoming a superpower.

critic.zh: 批评者将贝利亚视为历史上最残暴的刽子手之一。他们谴责他在大清洗期间直接导致数百万无辜苏联公民的死亡，建立了古拉格劳改营系统，造成了无数家庭的人间悲剧。批评者指出，贝利亚的统治手段极其残忍，包括使用酷刑、强迫认罪和大规模处决。他们认为贝利亚代表了极权主义最黑暗的一面，是斯大林主义暴政的主要执行者，其罪行不可饶恕，历史评价应当以负面为主。
critic.en: Critics regard Beria as one of the most brutal executioners in history. They condemn him for directly causing the deaths of millions of innocent Soviet citizens during the Great Purge, establishing the Gulag labor camp system, and creating countless human tragedies. Critics point out that Beria's methods of rule were extremely cruel, including the use of torture, forced confessions, and mass executions. They believe Beria represented the darkest side of totalitarianism, was the main enforcer of Stalinist tyranny, and his crimes are unforgivable, with his historical evaluation being predominantly negative.

objective.zh: 从客观历史视角看，贝利亚是斯大林时代复杂政治生态的典型代表。他既是苏联工业化和国防现代化的推动者，也是大规模政治镇压的执行者。历史学界普遍认为，贝利亚的生涯反映了苏联体制的矛盾性——在实现国家现代化的同时，付出了巨大的人道代价。在流行文化中，贝利亚常被描绘为冷酷无情的秘密警察头子，成为极权主义恐怖的象征符号。他的故事提醒人们，历史评价需要全面考量个人在特定历史条件下的角色与作用，而非简单二元对立。
objective.en: From an objective historical perspective, Beria represents the complex political ecology of the Stalin era. He was both a promoter of Soviet industrialization and defense modernization and an executor of large-scale political repression. The historical community generally believes that Beria's career reflects the contradictions of the Soviet system—achieving national modernization at the cost of enormous humanitarian sacrifice. In popular culture, Beria is often depicted as a ruthless head of secret police, becoming a symbolic representation of totalitarian terror. His story reminds us that historical evaluation requires comprehensive consideration of an individual's role and function under specific historical conditions, rather than simple binary opposition.

self.zh: 我们的任务是建立一个没有敌人的国家。
self.en: Our task is to build a state without enemies.
